crossRefs.note: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish…
Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man…
They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
“ ‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals…
I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few…
You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.
what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
“ ‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell…
In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the…
For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

translations.web: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.
translations.bsb: The fear and dread of you will fall on every living creature on the earth, every bird of the air, every creature that crawls on the ground, and all the fish of the sea. They are delivered into your hand.
translations.kjv: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
translations.asv: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every bird of the heavens; With all wherewith the ground teemeth, and all the fishes of the sea, into your hand are they delivered.
